broadcasts.name: auth.login_finished
broadcasts.doc: The daemon finished an authentication login flow.

broadcasts.name: notice
broadcasts.doc: The daemon sent an out-of-band notice.

broadcasts.name: message.committed
broadcasts.doc: The daemon committed a message to a session transcript.

broadcasts.name: transcript.truncated
broadcasts.doc: The daemon truncated older transcript messages.

broadcasts.name: message.discarded
broadcasts.doc: The daemon discarded an unfinished message.

broadcasts.name: message.part_added
broadcasts.doc: The daemon added a part to a message.

broadcasts.name: message.part_delta
broadcasts.doc: The daemon sent more content for a message part.

broadcasts.name: message.part_finalized
broadcasts.doc: The daemon attached final metadata to a stopped part.

broadcasts.name: tool.output_delta
broadcasts.doc: The daemon sent more output from a tool.

broadcasts.name: input.queued
broadcasts.doc: The daemon queued an input behind the active run.

broadcasts.name: input.canceled
broadcasts.doc: The daemon canceled a queued input.

structures.name: Client
structures.doc: This type identifies the client connection.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: The client connection name.

fields.name: version
fields.doc: The client build version.

structures.name: InitializeParams
structures.doc: These are the parameters for `initialize`. The `protocol` field defaults to `protocol_version`.

structures.name: SessionScopeAll
structures.doc: This option selects all workspaces and has no payload.

structures.name: SessionScopeWorkspace
structures.doc: This option selects one workspace.

structures.name: SubscriptionSetParams
structures.doc: This field lists the sessions whose live updates this connection requests.

structures.name: ContentText
structures.doc: This part holds plain text.

structures.name: ContentImage
structures.doc: This part holds an image source and an optional detail hint.

structures.name: ContentAudio
structures.doc: This part holds an audio source and its format.

structures.name: ContentFile
structures.doc: This part holds a file source and an optional file name.

structures.name: MediaBlob
structures.doc: The daemon fetches this content-addressed blob over HTTP.

structures.name: AuthCancelLoginParams
structures.doc: These are the parameters for `auth.cancel_login`.

structures.name: AuthChangedData
structures.doc: This payload describes `auth.changed`.

structures.name: AuthListResult
structures.doc: This result describes `auth.list`.

structures.name: AuthLoginFinishedData
structures.doc: This payload describes `auth.login_finished`.

structures.name: AuthLoginOutcomeCanceled
structures.doc: The login was explicitly canceled.

structures.name: AuthLoginOutcomeFailed
structures.doc: The login failed without changing durable credentials.

structures.name: AuthLoginOutcomeSucceeded
structures.doc: The daemon completed login and durably stored the credentials.

structures.name: AuthLoginParams
structures.doc: These are the parameters for `auth.login`.

structures.name: AuthLoginResultBrowser
structures.doc: The daemon returns these browser authorization details only to the connection that sent the request.

structures.name: AuthLoginResultDeviceCode
structures.doc: The daemon returns these device authorization details only to the connection that sent the request.

structures.name: AuthLoginSummary
structures.doc: This type identifies one daemon-owned login attempt. It contains no OAuth secret.

structures.name: AuthRemoveParams
structures.doc: These are the parameters for `auth.remove`. It removes a local credential; OAuth waits for stage 10.

structures.name: AuthProvider
structures.doc: Public authentication state and capabilities for one provider.

structures.name: AuthSetApiKeyParams
structures.doc: These are write-only parameters for `auth.set_api_key`. The wire state never returns or retains the key.

structures.name: DirEntry
structures.doc: One directory entry in a browse page.

fields.name: is_git_repo
fields.doc: True when this directory contains a `.git` entry.

structures.name: FsBrowseParams
structures.doc: These are the parameters for `fs.browse`.

fields.name: path
fields.doc: The directory to list. A null path selects the daemon home directory.

fields.name: limit
fields.doc: The daemon uses its default page size when this field is absent.

fields.name: cursor
fields.doc: An opaque cursor for continuation within the same directory.

fields.name: include_files
fields.doc: A false value lists directories only.

structures.name: FsBrowseResult
structures.doc: This result contains one browse page.

fields.name: parent
fields.doc: The daemon sets this field to null at the filesystem root.

fields.name: entries
fields.doc: The entries of this page in name order.

fields.name: next_cursor
fields.doc: An opaque continuation cursor; null on the final page.

structures.name: FsEntry
structures.doc: Metadata for one filesystem path. A symbolic link reports its target.

fields.name: last_modified_ms
fields.doc: The last modification time in epoch milliseconds.

fields.name: git
fields.doc: The daemon sets this field only for a Git repository.

structures.name: FsStatParams
structures.doc: These are the parameters for `fs.stat`.

structures.name: FsStatResult
structures.doc: This result describes one path. A null `entry` means the path does not exist.

fields.name: path
fields.doc: The absolute path that the daemon resolved.

structures.name: GitInfo
structures.doc: This type records Git state for a repository directory.

fields.name: branch
fields.doc: The current branch. Null means a detached HEAD.

structures.name: SkillInfo
structures.doc: This type records discovered skill metadata.

fields.name: scope
fields.doc: This scope identifies a project or personal skill.

structures.name: SkillRef
structures.doc: This type names a skill and holds its rendered arguments.

structures.name: Workspace
structures.doc: This type describes a workspace known to the daemon.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: The daemon creates this opaque workspace ID.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: The daemon supports only the local workspace kind at present.

fields.name: root
fields.doc: The canonical absolute path of the local root.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: The display title.

structures.name: WorkspaceCreatedData
structures.doc: This payload describes `workspace.created`.

fields.name: workspace
fields.doc: The newly known workspace.

structures.name: WorkspaceRef
structures.doc: These parameters name a workspace and nothing else.

fields.name: workspace_id
fields.doc: This field identifies the workspace that the request targets.

structures.name: WorkspaceRemoveResult
structures.doc: Result of `workspace.remove`.

structures.name: WorkspaceRemovedData
structures.doc: This payload describes `workspace.removed`.

fields.name: workspace_id
fields.doc: This field identifies the removed workspace.

structures.name: WorkspaceSkillsResult
structures.doc: This result lists discovered skills.

fields.name: skills
fields.doc: This field lists discovered skills.

structures.name: CatalogChangedData
structures.doc: This payload describes `catalog.changed`.

structures.name: CatalogListParams
structures.doc: These are the parameters for `catalog.list`.

structures.name: CatalogListResultFull
structures.doc: The client sent a stale or absent revision, so the daemon returns the full catalog.

structures.name: ProviderInfo
structures.doc: This type describes one configured provider. Its state tells a client why it cannot serve a turn.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: The provider name inside its origin. Two origins can use one id.

structures.name: CatalogListResultUnchanged
structures.doc: The client sent the current revision, so the daemon returns no catalog data.

structures.name: CatalogRefreshResult
structures.doc: This result describes `catalog.refresh`.

structures.name: ModelCost
structures.doc: These costs use United States dollars per million tokens.

structures.name: ModelInfo
structures.doc: This type exposes a closed projection of a provider model record. Its fields borrow their data.

fields.name: selector
fields.doc: The token that selects this model. A client echoes it back and never parses or builds it.

structures.name: Request
structures.doc: This type carries an RPC request.

structures.name: ResponseOk
structures.doc: This type carries a successful RPC response.

structures.name: ResponseError
structures.doc: This type carries a failed RPC response.

structures.name: Notification
structures.doc: This type carries an RPC notification.

structures.name: ActivityStateBuilding
structures.doc: This state marks the first phase of a run.

structures.name: ActivityStateCompacting
structures.doc: This state marks an active compaction model call.

structures.name: ActivityStateIdle
structures.doc: This state marks a session with no active work.

structures.name: ActivityStateReasoning
structures.doc: The model produces reasoning in this state.

structures.name: ActivityStateRetrying
structures.doc: This state marks a run that waits for a retry.

structures.name: ActivityStateRunning
structures.doc: This state marks an active run.

structures.name: ActivityStateRunningTool
structures.doc: This state marks an active tool call.

structures.name: ActivityStateWaitingPermission
structures.doc: This state marks a tool call that awaits permission.

structures.name: InputCanceledData
structures.doc: This payload describes `input.canceled`.

structures.name: InputContent
structures.doc: Raw content parts.

structures.name: InputQueuedData
structures.doc: This payload describes `input.queued`.

structures.name: InputSkill
structures.doc: This type describes a skill invocation.

structures.name: ActiveDraft
structures.doc: The daemon resends this assistant draft during resync. Its fields borrow their data.

structures.name: AssistantMessage
structures.doc: This payload describes an assistant transcript message. Its fields borrow their data.

structures.name: CompactionMessage
structures.doc: This payload describes a compaction transcript message. Its fields borrow their data.

structures.name: MessageCommittedData
structures.doc: This payload describes `message.committed`.

structures.name: MessageDiscardedData
structures.doc: This payload describes `message.discarded`.

structures.name: MessageError
structures.doc: This type describes an assistant error with `finish: "error"`. Its fields borrow their data.

structures.name: MessagePartAddedData
structures.doc: This payload describes `message.part_added`.

structures.name: MessagePartFinalizedData
structures.doc: This payload describes `message.part_finalized`. The daemon sends it at block stop.

structures.name: MessageStartedData
structures.doc: This payload describes `message.started` when the daemon opens a draft.

structures.name: MessageTime
structures.doc: Creation and completion times for an assistant message.

structures.name: PartDelta
structures.doc: This payload holds more text or reasoning bytes for a draft.

structures.name: ReasoningFinal
structures.doc: The daemon attaches the reasoning signature at block stop. An empty string means none.

structures.name: ReasoningPart
structures.doc: This payload describes a reasoning part in an assistant message. Its fields borrow their data.

structures.name: RedactedReasoningFinal
structures.doc: The daemon attaches the opaque redacted reasoning data at block stop.

structures.name: RedactedReasoningPart
structures.doc: This payload holds opaque, safety-redacted model reasoning. Its fields borrow their data.

structures.name: TextPart
structures.doc: This payload describes a text part in an assistant message. Its fields borrow their data.

structures.name: TokenUsage
structures.doc: This type records token counts for one assistant message.

structures.name: ToolPart
structures.doc: This payload describes a tool part in an assistant message. Its fields borrow their data.

structures.name: TurnProvenance
structures.doc: This type records the provider that produced an assistant turn. Its fields borrow their data.

structures.name: UserMessage
structures.doc: This payload describes a user transcript message. Its fields borrow their data.

structures.name: ConfigChangedData
structures.doc: This payload describes `config.changed`.

structures.name: CreateSession
structures.doc: These are the `session.create` input fields. They borrow their data.

structures.name: CreatedTime
structures.doc: This type records the creation time for a user or compaction message.

structures.name: DaemonInfo
structures.doc: This type records daemon identity and time. Its fields borrow their data.

structures.name: Empty
structures.doc: Empty params or result object.

structures.name: ErrorObject
structures.doc: This type records request failure details. Its fields borrow their data.

structures.name: InitializeResult
structures.doc: This result contains the coarse daemon snapshot after `initialize`.

structures.name: Notice
structures.doc: The daemon broadcasts this diagnostic notice to all connections. Its fields borrow their data.

structures.name: QueuedInput
structures.doc: This input waits behind an active turn.

structures.name: Session
structures.doc: The daemon owns this session summary.

structures.name: TranscriptTruncatedData
structures.doc: This payload describes `transcript.truncated`.

structures.name: PermissionDecideParams
structures.doc: These are the parameters for `permission.decide`.

structures.name: PermissionDecisionRule
structures.doc: A matched persisted rule decided the request.

structures.name: PermissionDecisionUser
structures.doc: The user selected an option for the decision.

structures.name: PermissionForgetParams
structures.doc: These are the parameters for `permission.forget`.

structures.name: PermissionOption
structures.doc: The daemon proposes this option for a permission request.

structures.name: PermissionRule
structures.doc: This rule stores an `allow always` answer for matching requests in a workspace.

structures.name: PermissionRulesChangedData
structures.doc: This payload describes `permission.rules_changed`.

structures.name: PermissionRulesResult
structures.doc: This result describes `permission.rules`.

structures.name: PermissionState
structures.doc: This local lifecycle data belongs in tool state. The daemon never broadcasts it.

structures.name: RunCanceledTiming
structures.doc: This type records run start and end times. The daemon records no start time when a queued run never starts.

structures.name: RunConfig
structures.doc: The daemon saves these run settings at run start.

structures.name: RunDoneData
structures.doc: This payload describes `run.done`.

structures.name: RunOutcomeCanceled
structures.doc: The user or daemon canceled the run. The terminal envelope carries its timing.

structures.name: RunOutcomeCompacted
structures.doc: The daemon completed a manual compaction and produced a summary.

structures.name: RunOutcomeFailed
structures.doc: The daemon reports failure after it exhausts its retry policy.

structures.name: RunOutcomeSkipped
structures.doc: The daemon skipped a manual compaction without producing a summary.

structures.name: RunOutcomeTurn
structures.doc: The daemon completed a turn after some round trips and recorded its stop reason.

structures.name: RunStartedData
structures.doc: This payload describes `run.started`.

structures.name: SessionActivity
structures.doc: Coarse live session state.

structures.name: SessionActivityChangedData
structures.doc: This payload describes `session.activity_changed`.

structures.name: SessionCancelInputParams
structures.doc: These are the parameters for `session.cancel_input`.

structures.name: SessionCancelInputResult
structures.doc: This result identifies the canceled input.

structures.name: SessionCancelRunParams
structures.doc: These are the parameters for `session.cancel_run`.

structures.name: SessionCancelRunResult
structures.doc: This result identifies the canceled run and cleared inputs.

structures.name: SessionCompactParams
structures.doc: These are the parameters for `session.compact`.

structures.name: SessionCompactResult
structures.doc: This result describes `session.compact`.

structures.name: SessionConfigParams
structures.doc: These are the parameters for `session.config.get`.

structures.name: SessionConfigResult
structures.doc: This result describes `session.config.get`.

structures.name: SessionDeltasShedData
structures.doc: This advisory notice tells the connection that the daemon dropped its live deltas.

structures.name: SessionForkParams
structures.doc: These are the parameters for `session.fork`.

structures.name: SessionHistoryParams
structures.doc: These are the parameters for `session.history`.

structures.name: SessionHistoryResult
structures.doc: This result describes `session.history`.

structures.name: SessionListItem
structures.doc: This row summarizes a session for `session.list` and session broadcasts. Its fields borrow their data.

structures.name: SessionListParams
structures.doc: These are the `session.list` input fields. They borrow their data.

structures.name: SessionListResult
structures.doc: This result contains one bounded `session.list` page. Its fields borrow their data.

structures.name: SessionOriginChild
structures.doc: This origin links a session to its parent session and message part.

structures.name: SessionOriginFork
structures.doc: This origin links a session to its source session.

structures.name: SessionOriginRoot
structures.doc: This origin marks a user-created root session.

structures.name: SessionPatch
structures.doc: An absent field leaves the current value unchanged. The daemon stores the system prompt at creation. The system prompt remains fixed, and the fields borrow their data.

structures.name: SessionPatchParams
structures.doc: These are the parameters for `session.patch`.

structures.name: SessionPopulationAll
structures.doc: This option selects every session regardless of origin.

structures.name: SessionPopulationChildren
structures.doc: This option selects the immediate persistent children of one session.

structures.name: SessionPopulationTopLevel
structures.doc: This option selects root sessions and forks for user-facing conversations.

structures.name: SessionRemoveParams
structures.doc: These are the parameters for `session.remove`.

structures.name: SessionRemovedData
structures.doc: This payload describes `session.removed`.

structures.name: SessionResult
structures.doc: This result contains the session after creation, a fork, or a patch.

structures.name: SessionResyncParams
structures.doc: These are the parameters for `session.resync`.

structures.name: SessionResyncResult
structures.doc: This result contains the full session snapshot for reconnection. Its fields borrow their data.

structures.name: SessionRewindParams
structures.doc: These are the parameters for `session.rewind`.

structures.name: SessionSendInputParams
structures.doc: These are the parameters for `session.send_input`.

structures.name: SessionSendInputResultQueued
structures.doc: The daemon queued the input behind an active turn.

structures.name: SessionSendInputResultStarted
structures.doc: The daemon started the input immediately.

structures.name: SessionSummaryChangedData
structures.doc: This payload describes `session.summary_changed`.

structures.name: ToolStateCanceled
structures.doc: The user or daemon canceled the call.

structures.name: ToolStateChangedData
structures.doc: This payload describes `tool.state_changed`.

structures.name: ToolStateCompleted
structures.doc: The tool call completed successfully.

structures.name: ToolStateDenied
structures.doc: The user or daemon denied permission for the call.

structures.name: ToolStateError
structures.doc: The tool call failed.

structures.name: ToolStatePending
structures.doc: The tool call has not started.

structures.name: ToolStateRunning
structures.doc: The tool call is active.

structures.name: ToolStateWaitingPermission
structures.doc: The tool call awaits a permission decision.

structures.name: DiffFile
structures.doc: This type describes one file in a diff view.

structures.name: DiffHunk
structures.doc: This type describes one hunk of a unified diff.

structures.name: ViewDiff
structures.doc: This view displays a unified diff.

structures.name: ViewImage
structures.doc: This view displays an image.

structures.name: ViewJson
structures.doc: This view displays JSON text.

structures.name: ViewMarkdown
structures.doc: This view displays Markdown text.

structures.name: ViewText
structures.doc: This view displays plain text.

unions.name: SessionScope
unions.doc: This scope filters `session.list` by workspace.

unions.name: ContentPart
unions.doc: This type describes one part of a message's content.

unions.name: MediaSource
unions.doc: This type identifies where media bytes live.

unions.name: AuthLoginOutcome
unions.doc: This union reports the terminal outcome of a daemon-owned login attempt.

unions.name: AuthLoginResult
unions.doc: This result identifies the mechanism that the daemon started for `auth.login`.

unions.name: CatalogListResult
unions.doc: This result reports a catalog unchanged since `since_rev`, or a full catalog snapshot.

unions.name: ActivityState
unions.doc: This state holds locator fields that let clients detect drift and resync.

unions.name: Input
unions.doc: This type accepts raw content or a skill invocation. Its fields borrow their data.

unions.name: AssistantPart
unions.doc: This type describes one element of an assistant message's content. Its fields borrow their data.

unions.name: Message
unions.doc: This union describes a transcript message. Its fields borrow their data.

unions.name: PartFinal
unions.doc: The final metadata for a stopped reasoning part. Tool parts finalize through `tool.state_changed`.

unions.name: PermissionDecision
unions.doc: This type records who answered a permission request and how. Its fields borrow their data.

unions.name: RunOutcome
unions.doc: This union describes the terminal run outcome. The `type` field selects the outcome.

unions.name: SessionOrigin
unions.doc: This union records how the daemon created the session.

unions.name: SessionPopulation
unions.doc: This union selects the session relationships that `session.list` returns.

unions.name: SessionSendInputResult
unions.doc: This result says whether the daemon started or queued the input.

unions.name: ToolState
unions.doc: This union records a tool part's lifecycle state. Its fields borrow their data.

unions.name: View
unions.doc: A frontend can render this hint natively or ignore it. Its fields borrow their data.

unions.name: RequestParams
unions.doc: This union carries client request parameters.

unions.name: ResponseResult
unions.doc: This union carries server response results.

unions.name: BroadcastData
unions.doc: This union carries server broadcast data.

unions.name: Response
unions.doc: This union carries an RPC response.
